verses.en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Escutai, céus, e falarei; E ouça a terra os ditos de minha boca.
verses.en_web: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O heavens, to my voice; let the earth take note of the words of my mouth:

verses.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.pt: Gotejará como a chuva minha doutrina; Destilará como o orvalho meu discurso; Como o chuvisco sobre a grama, E como as gotas sobre a erva:
verses.en_web: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
verses.en_bbe: My teaching is dropping like rain, coming down like dew on the fields; like rain on the young grass and showers on the garden plants:

verses.en: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.pt: Porque invocarei o nome do SENHOR; Engrandecei ao nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
verses.en_bbe: For I will give honour to the name of the Lord: let our God be named great.

verses.en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.pt: Ele é a Rocha, sua obra é perfeita, pois todos os seus caminhos são justos. Deus fiel, e sem imoralidade; justo e correto ele é.
verses.en_web: The Rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
verses.en_bbe: He is the Rock, complete is his work; for all his ways are righteousness: a God without evil who keeps faith, true and upright is he.

verses.en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.pt: Corromperam-se contra ele; não são seus filhos, a falha é deles. São uma geração perversa e distorcida.
verses.en_web: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.en_bbe: They have become false, they are not his children, the mark of sin is on them; they are an evil and hard-hearted generation.

verses.en: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.pt: É assim que pagais ao SENHOR, ó povo tolo e insensato? Não é ele teu pai que te adquiriu, te fez, e te estabeleceu?
verses.en_web: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
verses.en_bbe: Is this your answer to the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? Is he not your father who has given you life? He has made you and given you your place.

verses.en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.pt: Lembra-te dos tempos antigos; Considerai os anos de geração e geração: Pergunta a teu pai, que ele te declarará; A teus anciãos, e eles te dirão.
verses.en_web: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind the days of the past, give thought to the years of generations gone by: go to your father and he will make it clear to you, to the old men and they will give you the story.

verses.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Quando o Altíssimo fez herdar às nações, Quando fez dividir os filhos dos homens, Estabeleceu os termos dos povos Segundo o número dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: When the Most High gave the nations their heritage, separating into groups the children of men, he had the limits of the peoples marked out, keeping in mind the number of the children of Israel.

verses.en: For the LORD’S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.pt: Porque a parte do SENHOR é seu povo; Jacó a medida de sua herança.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord's wealth is his people; Jacob is the land of his heritage.

verses.en: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.pt: Achou-o em terra de deserto, E em deserto horrível e ermo; Cercou-o, instruiu-o, Guardou-o como a menina de seu olho.
verses.en_web: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.en_bbe: He came to him in the waste land, in the unpeopled waste of sand: putting his arms round him and caring for him, he kept him as the light of his eye.

verses.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.pt: Como a água desperta sua ninhada, paira sobre seus passarinhos, estende suas asas, os toma, os leva sobre suas penas;
verses.en_web: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
verses.en_bbe: As an eagle, teaching her young to make their flight, with her wings outstretched over them, takes them up on her strong feathers:

verses.en: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.pt: o SENHOR sozinho o guiou, e nenhum deus estrangeiro esteve com ele.
verses.en_web: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord only was his guide, no other god was with him.

verses.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.pt: Ele o fez cavalgar sobre os lugares altos da terra; alimentou-o com os frutos do campo, e o fez sugar mel da rocha e azeite da dura pederneira;
verses.en_web: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.en_bbe: He put him on the high places of the earth, his food was the increase of the field; honey he gave him out of the rock and oil out of the hard rock;

verses.en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.pt: manteiga de vacas e leite de ovelhas, com gordura de cordeiros, e carneiros de Basã; também machos de bode, com o melhor do trigo; e bebeste o sangue das uvas, o vinho puro.
verses.en_web: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
verses.en_bbe: Butter from his cows and milk from his sheep, with fat of lambs and sheep of Bashan, and goats, and the heart of the grain; and for your drink, wine from the blood of the grape.

verses.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.pt: E engordou Jesurum, e deu coices: engordaste-te, engrossaste-te, cobriste-te: e deixou ao Deus que lhe fez, e menosprezou a Rocha de sua salvação.
verses.en_web: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
verses.en_bbe: But Jeshurun became fat and would not be controlled: you have become fat, you are thick and full of food: then he was untrue to the God who made him, giving no honour to the Rock of his salvation.

verses.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.pt: Provocaram-lhe ciúmes com os deuses alheios; irritaram-lhe com abominações.
verses.en_web: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
verses.en_bbe: The honour which was his they gave to strange gods; by their disgusting ways he was moved to wrath.

verses.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.pt: Sacrificaram aos demônios, não a Deus; a deuses que não conheciam, a novos deuses vindos de perto, Que não haviam temido vossos pais.
verses.en_web: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
verses.en_bbe: They made offerings to evil spirits which were not God, to gods who were strange to them, which had newly come up, not feared by your fathers.

verses.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.pt: Abandonaste a Rocha que te gerou; e te esqueceste do Deus que te criou.
verses.en_web: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
verses.en_bbe: You have no thought for the Rock, your father, you have no memory of the God who gave you birth.

verses.en: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR o viu, e acendeu-se em ira, pelo menosprezo de seus filhos e de suas filhas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord saw with disgust the evil-doing of his sons and daughters.

verses.en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.pt: E disse: esconderei deles meu rosto, verei qual será seu fim; pois são geração de perversidades, filhos sem fidelidade.
verses.en_web: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, My face will be veiled from them, I will see what their end will be: for they are an uncontrolled generation, children in whom is no faith.

verses.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.pt: Eles me provocaram ciúmes com o que não é Deus; com suas vaidades provocaram-me à ira; eu também provocarei os ciúmes com aqueles que não são povo, e com uma nação insensata eu os provocarei à ira.
verses.en_web: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.en_bbe: They have given my honour to that which is not God, moving me to wrath with their false worship: I will give their honour to those who are not a people, moving them to wrath by a foolish nation,

verses.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.pt: Porque um fogo se acendeu em meu furor, e arderá até as profundezas do Xeol; e consumirá a terra e seus frutos, e abrasará os fundamentos dos montes.
verses.en_web: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
verses.en_bbe: For my wrath is a flaming fire, burning to the deep parts of the underworld, burning up the earth with her increase, and firing the deep roots of the mountains.

verses.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.pt: Eu trarei males sobre eles; gastarei neles minhas flechas.
verses.en_web: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
verses.en_bbe: I will send a rain of troubles on them, my arrows will be showered on them.

verses.en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.pt: Consumidos serão de fome, e comidos de febre ardente E de amarga pestilência; Dente de animais enviarei também sobre eles, Com veneno de serpente da terra.
verses.en_web: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
verses.en_bbe: They will be wasted from need of food, and overcome by burning heat and bitter destruction; and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of the worms of the dust.

verses.en: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.pt: De fora desolará a espada, E dentro das câmaras o espanto: Tanto ao rapaz como à virgem, Ao que mama como o homem grisalho.
verses.en_web: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror; on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
verses.en_bbe: Outside they will be cut off by the sword, and in the inner rooms by fear; death will take the young man and the virgin, the baby at the breast and the grey-haired man.

verses.en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.pt: Disse: Eu os dispersaria do mundo, Faria cessar dentre os homens a memória deles,
verses.en_web: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
verses.en_bbe: I said I would send them wandering far away, I would make all memory of them go from the minds of men:

verses.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.pt: Se não temesse a ira do inimigo, Não seja que se envaideçam seus adversários, Não seja que digam: Nossa mão alta fez tudo isto, não o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted, Yahweh has not done all this.’”
verses.en_bbe: But for the fear that their haters, uplifted in their pride, might say, Our hand is strong, the Lord has not done all this.

verses.en: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.pt: Porque são gente de perdidos conselhos, E não há neles entendimento.
verses.en_web: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
verses.en_bbe: For they are a nation without wisdom; there is no sense in them.

verses.en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.pt: Bom seria se fossem sábios, que compreendessem isto, E entendessem seu fim!
verses.en_web: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.en_bbe: If only they were wise, if only this was clear to them, and they would give thought to their future!

verses.en: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.pt: Como poderia perseguir um a mil, E dois fariam fugir a dez mil, Se sua Rocha não os houvesse vendido, E o SENHOR não os houvesse entregue?
verses.en_web: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
verses.en_bbe: How would it be possible for one to overcome a thousand, and two to send ten thousand in flight, if their rock had not let them go, if the Lord had not given them up?

verses.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.pt: Que a rocha deles não é como nossa Rocha: E nossos inimigos sejam disso juízes.
verses.en_web: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
verses.en_bbe: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our haters themselves being judges.

verses.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.pt: Porque da vide de Sodoma é a vide deles, E dos sarmentos de Gomorra: As uvas deles são uvas venenosas, cachos muito amargos têm.
verses.en_web: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
verses.en_bbe: For their vine is the vine of Sodom, from the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are the grapes of evil, and the berries are bitter:

verses.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.pt: Veneno de serpentes é seu vinho, e peçonha cruel de áspides.
verses.en_web: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
verses.en_bbe: Their wine is the poison of dragons, the cruel poison of snakes.

verses.en: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.pt: Não tenho eu isto guardado, Selado em meus tesouros?
verses.en_web: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
verses.en_bbe: Is not this among my secrets, kept safe in my store-house?

verses.en: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.pt: Minha é a vingança e o pagamento, Ao tempo que seu pé vacilará; Porque o dia de sua aflição está próximo, E o que lhes está preparado se apressa.
verses.en_web: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
verses.en_bbe: Punishment is mine and reward, at the time of the slipping of their feet: for the day of their downfall is near, sudden will be their fate.

verses.en: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.pt: Porque o SENHOR julgará a seu povo, E por causa de seus servos se arrependerá, Quando vir que a força pereceu, E que não há prisioneiro nem livre.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will be judge of his people, he will have pity for his servants; when he sees that their power is gone, there is no one, shut up or free.

verses.en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.pt: E dirá: Onde estão seus deuses, A rocha em que se refugiavam;
verses.en_web: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge;
verses.en_bbe: And he will say, Where are their gods, the rock in which they put their faith?

verses.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.pt: Que comiam a gordura de seus sacrifícios, Bebiam o veio de suas libações? Levante-se, que vos ajudem E vos defendam.
verses.en_web: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
verses.en_bbe: Who took the fat of their offerings, and the wine of their drink offering? Let them now come to your help, let them be your salvation.

verses.en: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.pt: Vede agora que Eu, Eu Sou, e não há deus além de mim; eu trago a morte, e eu faço viver; eu firo, e eu curo; e não há quem possa escapar da minha mão.
verses.en_web: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
verses.en_bbe: See now, I myself am he; there is no other god but me: giver of death and life, wounding and making well: and no one has power to make you free from my hand.

verses.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.pt: Quando eu erguer aos céus minha mão, e disser: “Tão certo como eu vivo para sempre”,
verses.en_web: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
verses.en_bbe: For lifting up my hand to heaven I say, By my unending life,

verses.en: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.pt: Se eu afiar minha espada reluzente, e minha mão agarrar o juízo, devolverei a vingança sobre os meus adversários, e retribuirei aos que me odeiam.
verses.en_web: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
verses.en_bbe: If I make sharp my shining sword, and my hand is outstretched for judging, I will give punishment to those who are against me, and their right reward to my haters.

verses.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.pt: Embriagarei de sangue minhas flechas, e minha espada devorará carne, no sangue dos mortos e dos cativos, das cabeças dos líderes inimigos.
verses.en_web: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
verses.en_bbe: I will make my arrows red with blood, my sword will be feasting on flesh, with the blood of the dead and the prisoners, of the long-haired heads of my haters.

verses.en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.pt: Jubilai, ó nações, com o povo dele, porque ele vingará o sangue dos seus servos, e devolverá a vingança sobre os seus inimigos, e expiará sua terra, pelo seu povo.
verses.en_web: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
verses.en_bbe: Be glad, O you his people, over the nations; for he will take payment for the blood of his servants, and will give punishment to his haters, and take away the sin of his land, for his people.

verses.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.pt: E Moisés veio, e recitou todas as palavras deste cântico aos ouvidos do povo, ele, e Josué filho de Num.
verses.en_web: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses said all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Hoshea, the son of Nun.

verses.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.pt: E acabou Moisés de recitar todas estas palavras a todo Israel;
verses.en_web: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And after saying all this to the people,

verses.en: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Ponde vosso coração a todas as palavras que eu vos declaro hoje, para que as mandeis a vossos filhos, e cuidem de praticar todas as palavras desta lei.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.en_bbe: Moses said to them, Let the words which I have said to you today go deep into your hearts, and give orders to your children to do every word of this law.

verses.en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.pt: Porque não vos é coisa vã, mas é vossa vida: e por elas fareis prolongar os dias sobre a terra, para possuir a qual passais o Jordão.
verses.en_web: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
verses.en_bbe: And this is no small thing for you, but it is your life, and through this you may make your days long in the land which you are going over Jordan to take for your heritage.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés aquele mesmo dia, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
verses.en_bbe: That same day the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.pt: Sobe a este monte de Abarim, ao monte Nebo, que está na terra de Moabe, que está em frente de Jericó, e olha a terra de Canaã, que eu dou por herança aos filhos de Israel;
verses.en_web: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
verses.en_bbe: Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab opposite Jericho; there you may see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel for their heritage:

verses.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.pt: E morre no monte ao qual sobes, e sê reunido a teus povos; ao modo que morreu Arão teu irmão no monte de Hor, e foi reunido a seus povos:
verses.en_web: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
verses.en_bbe: And let death come to you on the mountain where you are going, and be put to rest with your people; as death came to Aaron, your brother, on Mount Hor, where he was put to rest with his people:

verses.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Porquanto transgredistes contra mim em meio dos filhos de Israel nas águas da briga de Cades, no deserto de Zim; porque não me santificastes em meio dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your sin against me before the children of Israel at the waters of Meribath Kadesh in the waste land of Zin; because you did not keep my name holy among the children of Israel.

verses.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Verás, portanto, diante de ti a terra; mas não entrarás ali, à terra que dou aos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: So you will see the land before you, but you will not go into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel.
